summary: Map app.exit(code) to immediate host termination semantics, distinct from app.quit().

target.notes: The helper must close/terminate immediately without Electron before-quit or will-quit lifecycle events; default code is 0 when omitted.

caveats: Environment.Exit can be the final primitive only if the compatibility layer has first reproduced Electron's immediate-close semantics relevant to translated windows.

tests.name: default exit code
tests.expected_behavior: process terminates immediately with exit code 0

tests.name: custom exit code
tests.expected_behavior: process terminates immediately with exit code 7 without before-quit/will-quit
